shots.still: Close-up of an adult woman's face and bare shoulders on a tropical beach at golden hour, long brown hair, soft closed-mouth smile, warm backlight, ocean softly blurred behind her, swimwear commercial, cinematic, no text.
shots.motion: Her hair blows in the wind and she turns her head slightly toward the camera. Her face stays calm with the same soft smile.
shots.caption: Golden hour.
